mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600K units, sustained for 2 months, indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by > 200K in the preceding month, the combined signal predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 200K in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 5% YoY indicates strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth slowing to < 2% QoQ, sustained for 2 quarters, signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 2% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increasing by > 50bps in a single month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by > 0.5pp in 2 months and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to < 100K, the combined signal predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rise > 0.5pp in 2 months and PAYEMS growth < 100K
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) growth exceeding 8% YoY, sustained for 3 months, indicates robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered non-recessionary instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
